name: servicebook
description: ServiceBook — vehicle maintenance log: km/time reminders, AI receipt scan, price comparison. Runs free on Cloudflare Workers + D1.

scripts.release:edge: cd edge && wrangler pages deploy public --project-name servicebook-edge --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy: npm run db:migrations:apply && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy

APP_PASSWORD.description: The password you will sign in with. Choose a long one only you know (you can change it later in Settings).

SESSION_SECRET.description: Any **long random text** (40+ characters, e.g. from a password manager). It signs your login sessions and encrypts API keys you save in the app. Keep a copy: changing it later signs you out and you must paste saved API keys again.
